evidence.claim: Flagged transaction 3506725 is a $1,000.03 online transaction with risk_score 0.90, which is at the 99.8th percentile of customer C10434 historical amounts (baseline median: $38.50, mean: $62.15).
Transaction originated from a device profile marked New for this account (Windows | Windows 10 | edge 16.0 | 1366x768; id_15 = 'New'). Customer history shows exclusively mobile devices.
Transaction was executed under ProductCD 'R' (online service/risk-transfer channel), a category never previously utilized by this cardholder.
Customer contacted for out-of-band validation explicitly denied authorizing the transaction, confirming they still maintain physical possession of card C10434-K1.

case.summary: High-risk alert on transaction 3506725 ($1,000.03, online, risk score 0.90). Evidence demonstrates an extreme deviation from customer spending baseline ($38.50 median), originating from an unrecognized desktop device profile marked New for this account. Cardholder confirmed physical possession of the card and explicitly denied authorizing the charge. Activity represents card-not-present fraud via compromised card credentials. Card blocked under L1 approval and SAR filing initiated under L2 approval due to exposure exceeding $1,000.

evidence_requests.assumed_response: Customer states: 'I never made any online purchase for $1,000.03. I still have my physical card with me. Please block it immediately.'

R1: Probability below 0.85 on single signal; verify with customer before taking irreversible card blocking action.

final.reason: R2: Customer explicitly denied the transaction. Total exposure of $1,000.03 is <= $2,500, requiring L1 team lead approval.

R2 & Policy 3a: Confirmed unauthorized use where exposure of $1,000.03 exceeds the $1,000 filing threshold; requires L2 fraud manager approval.

next_best_actions.what_changed: Customer explicit denial of the $1,000.03 charge elevated fraud probability from 0.75 to 0.92, confirming account compromise. This escalated recommended actions from verification to L1 BLOCK_CARD and triggered mandatory L2 FILE_REPORT under policy R2 due to exposure exceeding $1,000.

sar.reason: Policy R2 & FinCEN Guidance: Confirmed unauthorized card-not-present fraud exceeding $1,000 threshold ($1,000.03) from an unrecognized new device profile.
sar.narrative: On 2016-12-02 at 18:18:27, an unauthorized online transaction of $1,000.03 (TransactionID 3506725) was initiated on card C10434-K1 belonging to customer C10434. The transaction was scored at 0.90 by the bank's real-time risk model and originated from an unrecognized new device profile (Windows | Windows 10 | edge 16.0 | 1366x768; id_15 = 'New'), inconsistent with the cardholder's historical device usage. The amount of $1,000.03 represents an extreme departure from the customer's median spending baseline of $38.50. Upon contact, the cardholder explicitly denied authorizing the transaction and confirmed continuous physical possession of the card, indicating card credential compromise for card-not-present fraud. Total exposure is $1,000.03. Card C10434-K1 has been blocked and scheduled for reissue with customer reimbursement.

stop_reason: Customer denial settled the fraud verdict. Exposure of $1,000.03 confirmed. Card blocked and regulatory SAR filing recommended under Policy R2. Further investigative steps would not alter the required actions.
